title: loam intake list --json
description: The open issues of the GitHub repos of a plot, the newest change first, then the open tickets of the maps in its links, in number order.

sources.description: Each GitHub repo of the plot, and each map in its links.

label.description: The repo, such as example/widgets, or the label of the map link.

error.description: Why Loam could not read the source, or empty.

key.description: #48, owner/repo#48, or map 135. It is the key of a run that starts from the item.

status.description: For a person to read: Open, or Blocked by 135.

url.description: The web page of an issue, for run start --link, or the path of a ticket file, for run start --ticket.

updated_at.description: The last change on GitHub, or empty for a ticket.

run_id.description: The newest run that started from the item, or empty.
